dual_geometry.verdict: incidence duality swaps object type rather than producing a second spread family

route_shell.interpretation: the Pass-209 silent W-spread is literally a Q(4,3) ovoid on the dual point set

owner_design.owner_map: 30 external points -> 15 duad blocks with uniform fibre 2
owner_design.mate_theorem: the two points in one fibre are noncollinear, have that owner block as their full common perp, and have antiregular span equal to the pair
owner_design.S6_atlas: the 10 ovoid points are 3+3 bisections and the 15 owner blocks are exactly duads; a duad owns the four bisections in which its entries lie on one side

carrier.source: (Omega,x,m), Omega a Q43 ovoid, x external, and m a Q-line through x
carrier.inverse: a path (x,y,z) has a unique Omega containing y with equal endpoint owner sets; m is the unique line xy
carrier.factorization: 4320=36 ovoids * 15 duads * 2 owner-mate endpoints * 4 owner choices
